narrative: Analysis of material PL1__M0506790 reveals a lumpy demand pattern with CV=0.767, indicating empirical/gamma-proxy modeling is appropriate. The demand exhibits no significant trend over the observation period. Given the demand variability and lead time characteristics (mean=2.53d, stability=unstable), a continuous review (r,Q) policy is recommended with reorder point 3086 and order quantity 3335.
